Number 50. Why is the requested chamber unavailable on Wednesday?

We need the reliability chamber for three days, starting Wednesday. Is it available? Another team has booked it through Thursday. You could begin Friday morning, or use the smaller chamber on Wednesday. The smaller one cannot hold all 12 samples. Let us choose Friday, and I will notify the project manager about the revised completion date. I will reserve the larger chamber for you. Please bring the test plan when you check in. [BLANK_AUDIO]
